## Need

Pilot 5 takes as its starting point two cases that describe the same problem from opposite ends of the educational pathway:

- [case 3 – Handling of D numbers](/en/behov/use-cases/03-id-haandtering-flyktninger/), submitted by Bergen municipality
- [case 26 – National service for identifying persons in education (education person register)](/en/behov/use-cases/26-nasjonal-tjeneste-for-identifikasjon-av-personer-i-utdanning-utdanningspersonregister/), submitted by Sikt

Case 3 is about municipalities that lack a common solution for identifying children and young people who have not yet received a D number or national identity number (fødselsnummer). Today the municipalities create fictitious identity numbers according to their own rules, without coordination across municipalities and sectors. Case 26 extends the problem to the whole educational pathway, and to the many foreign students, pupils and employees who are not in the National Population Register (Folkeregisteret).

Without unique identification, duplicates arise, data cannot be linked across systems and levels, and children and parents may lose access and history when a fictitious number is replaced by an official one. Fictitious numbers also do not allow login with ID-porten.

## Objective

The pilot shall do the preparatory work before a possible national service for identifying persons in education. It shall map the problem area and the alternative solutions, clarify what the National Population Register can and cannot solve, and map the legal prerequisites for a common education ID and an education person register.

## Scope and delimitation

The pilot shall deliver:

- a report that summarises the mapping
- a recommendation for the way forward
- a legal memo, as part of a basis that can be raised with the relevant ministry
- possible input to SAMT-BU's final deliverables

The pilot shall describe possible alternative solutions and role models, but not decide on the choice of solution, ownership or division of roles. It produces no technical products.
